args.summary:
Model of a four-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous box-girder bridge (35+45+45+35 m, deck 12.5 m wide) built as a 2D spine-beam idealization.

Structure: single-cell cast_box section (h=2.2 m, B_top=12.5 m, B_bot=6.5 m, t_top=0.25 m, t_bot=0.22 m, t_web=0.45 m, cantilever 0.5→0.2 m); section properties from integration A=6.712 m², I=4.498 m⁴; C50 concrete, Ec=34500 MPa; γ=26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-4.2.1), girder self-weight only w=174.512 kN/m, m=17.789 t/m.

System: continuous_on_piers (MR-05) with twin 1.8 m dia C40 piers modeled as equivalent single columns (Pier 1 H=26 m, Pier 2 H=10 m, Pier 3 H=29 m; A=5.0894 m², I=1.0306 m⁴, Ec=32500 MPa), fixed at base.

Bearings: PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric at Abutments 0/4 (400×500, 5×11 mm) and Piers 1/3 (550×650, 6×11 mm), plain elastomeric fixed at Pier 2 (600×700, 7×11 mm), two per line. Ge=1.2 MPa (manufacturer value) used; vertical springs Kv per line = 3.61e6 / 8.08e6 / 8.97e6 kN/m; Kh=0 for sliding supports, 13091 kN/m at the fixed Pier 2.

Loading: Highway Class I, one-way, 3 lanes (ξ=0.78), qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=330 kN (35 m spans) and 350 kN (45 m spans); impact factor μ=0.1572 from f1=2.660 Hz (JTG D60-4.3.2).

Results: f1=2.660 Hz (vertical bending); total self-weight reaction ≈ 27,922 kN, with the fixed Pier 2 line carrying largest share; max lane-loading sagging moment 11,539 kN·m (span 3) and hogging −9,597 kN·m (support 2). All L1 topology, L2 code and L3 mechanics checks passed.
